title: To reauthorize the West Valley demonstration project, and for other purposes.
official_summary:
This bill reauthorizes through FY2026 the West Valley Demonstration Project located in West Valley, New York.

The Government Accountability Office must report to Congress on the volumes, origins, and types of radioactive waste at the West Valley Demonstration Project and the options for disposal of such waste.

summary.headline: This law extends the authorization of a federal cleanup project for radioactive waste in West Valley, New York, through fiscal year 2026 and requires a federal report on that waste.
summary.what_it_does: The law reauthorizes the West Valley Demonstration Project in West Valley, New York, through fiscal year 2026. It also requires the Government Accountability Office to report to Congress on the volumes, origins, and types of radioactive waste at the site. The report must also cover options for disposing of that waste.

who_it_affects.group: Residents of West Valley, New York, and nearby communities
who_it_affects.how: The project's continued authorization keeps the federal waste work at the site going for several more years.
The department's authority to run the West Valley Demonstration Project is extended through fiscal year 2026.
Lawmakers will receive a Government Accountability Office report on the site's radioactive waste and disposal options.

summary.when_it_takes_effect: The law was enacted on December 20, 2019, and the project's authorization runs through fiscal year 2026.
